newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds prices mixed on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds prices mixed on quiet market.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers were mixed on Wednesday with high protein soymeal higher while rapemeal offers were trimmed.
Trading remains quiet with no compounder demand seen.
"Compounders are covered and no see any reason to buy forward at the moment," said one broker.
However, one trade was reported when 32/33 percent protein sunflower meal traded at 95 stg for spot ex-store Teignmouth.
High protein soymeal was offered ex-mill around two stg up while store were one stg higher.
On the rapemeal market material from the Erith mill was around one stg down while the Hull and Liverpool mills were two stg down.
Corn gluten feed pellets, sunflower pellets and sunflower meal were all unchanged.
